title: Surreal Gallery Wanderer
description: A man in a yellow Victorian-style coat stands in a decaying, sand-filled art gallery with cracked floors and peeling frescoes. He holds a glowing framed painting of the aurora borealis while ghostly green faces peer from other artworks under a broken ceiling revealing a purple night sky with film strips, a crescent moon, and radiation symbols in the desert beyond.
prompt: A lone man wearing a long yellow coat and carrying a satchel stands inside a ruined classical art gallery filled with sand. The floor is cracked and partially covered in dunes. He holds up a glowing framed painting depicting green and purple aurora borealis. Ghostly green faces with glowing eyes emerge from other classical paintings on the decaying walls. The ceiling is broken open revealing a twilight purple sky with floating film strip reels and a crescent moon. In the background through an opening is a desert landscape with radiation warning symbols. Dramatic spotlight from above casting long shadows, cinematic surreal composition.
